newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU probes Blokker takover of Dutch Toys R Us unit.
newsitem.headline: EU probes Blokker takover of Dutch Toys R Us unit.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it had started an in-depth probe into the proposed takeover of the Dutch Toys 'R Us unit by Blokker Holding BV saying that it needed to assess fully the impact of the deal on fair competition in the Netherlands.

"Blokker has by far the largest market share as a toy retailer in the Netherlands and therefore holds a significant position as a retailer and as a purchaser of toys," the Commission said in a statement.
It said it would assess the effect of the combination of the Toy 'R Us megastores with Blokker's knowledge of the Dutch retail market.
The deal was submitted for clearance by the Dutch authorities. The Commission would otherwise not have competence over the operation.

Toys 'R Us Netherlands is a wholly owned subsidiary of Toys 'R Us Inc of the United States, one of the world's biggest toy retailers. It currently operates nine megastores in the Netherlands of which three would be closed if the operation was approved.
